//: The one source for the protocol numbers, the capability strings and the permission-mode strings. Read by crates/claude-runtime-protocol/build.rs (Rust constants) and by apps/claude-sidecar/scripts/generateProtocolConstants.mjs (TypeScript constants); tests on both sides fail if either drifts from this file. Rules and the meaning of each field: COMPATIBILITY.md next to this file.

minors.summary: Protocol 3: the settings tiers and the tool policy on CreateSession (capabilities setting_sources, tool_policy). Every capability with baseline true is guaranteed by major 3 alone.
The executable sources a build can serve, as capabilities (executable_host_cli, executable_sdk_bundled); the wire field existed before.
ToolPolicy.unrestricted, and SessionReady.permission_mode (the mode the CLI reports it took). No capability.
CreateSession.model and .effort (session_model, session_effort).
CreateSession.system_prompt (system_prompt).
CreateSession.output_format (output_format).
TurnCompleted structured output and the result's own words (structured_output).
TurnCompleted.usage (turn_usage).
The account binding in the handshake and SessionReady.account_identity (account_identity).
SessionReady.init_fingerprint and the zero-tools close reason (init_fingerprint).
The explicit allow list is verified against system/init, and egress is proved at startup (tool_allow_list, egress_restricted). No wire change.
SetPermissionMode, and message ids on text and thinking deltas (set_permission_mode, text_delta_message_id); CreateSession.permission_mode_switchable.
Provider permission prompts: CreateSession.provider_permission_prompts and PermissionRequested.origin and its provider_* fields (provider_permission_prompts).

Explicit fields for what the sidecar used to infer from a request's shape: ToolAllowList.init_check, CreateSession.await_account_identity and its response's account_identity, the handshake's egress_probe and structured_output_tools, and SessionReady's effective_disallowed_tools and effective_tools (init_check, await_account_identity, egress_probe, structured_output_tools, effective_tool_report).
wire_additions: verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.SessionReady: new field repeated string effective_disallowed_tools = 8

minors.summary: The CLI's own auto mode under the gate, a deferring answer, and the CLI's own refusals as events: ClaudeHostPolicy.cli_permission_mode, ResolvePermission.defer and PermissionOutcome DEFERRED, and the PermissionDenied event for a session that states the CLI mode (cli_auto_mode, permission_defer, permission_denied_events).
wire_additions: verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.SessionEvent: new field optional .verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.PermissionDenied permission_denied = 23 (oneof event)

minors.summary: The CLI's compatibility verdict in the handshake, and an opt-in process mode in which the host decides per session whether to run on a CLI the sidecar refuses: HandshakeResponse.cli_compatibility and .bundled_cli_compatibility, ClaudeHostPolicy.accept_unsupported_cli (cli_compatibility_report). The capability gated_cli_mode_default states, and does not change, that a gated session starts in the CLI's `default` mode.

The configuration directory the CLI really uses, in the handshake: HandshakeResponse.effective_claude_config_dir (effective_claude_config_dir). The sidecar's account module now knows only explicit directories; the name-to-directory layout moved into a legacy module of the sidecar, with no change to what any input resolves to.

A machine-readable startup report: with VERDANDI_CLAUDE_SIDECAR_REPORT_FILE set the process writes one JSON line per startup outcome (ready after it listens, refused before it exits, diagnostic for an accepted but untested CLI) beside the unchanged stderr text, and ErrorDetail.reason names which rule refused a request (startup_report_file).
wire_additions: verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.ErrorDetail: new field optional string reason = 3

minors.summary: What a session really loaded, reported once on SessionReady: the setting tiers and configuration profile it handed the SDK, and the CLI's permission mode as an enum next to the unchanged verbatim string (effective_session_report).

MCP servers declared by the process that starts the sidecar: VERDANDI_CLAUDE_EXTRA_MCP_SERVERS merges stdio servers (extra_mcp_servers) and http servers whose headers come from the sidecar's environment (extra_mcp_servers_http) into every session's mcpServers; an ISOLATED session that has them also turns the claude.ai connectors off; a verified allow list permits the declared servers' tools and requires exactly those servers, connected. No wire change.

Steering and the slash-command list: the SteerTurn RPC adds a user message to the running turn (priority next) and the UserMessageDelivered and UserMessageDropped events report its fate, read from the CLI's command_lifecycle frames, with error codes TURN_MISMATCH and STEER_UNAVAILABLE (steer_turn, advertised only when the host CLI is at least 2.1.252; each session still needs its CLI to list msg_lifecycle_v1); the CommandsUpdated event carries the session's slash commands after start and on every change (list_commands).
wire_additions: verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.SessionEvent: new field optional .verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.UserMessageDelivered user_message_delivered = 24 (oneof event)
verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.SessionEvent: new field optional .verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.UserMessageDropped user_message_dropped = 25 (oneof event)
verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.SessionEvent: new field optional .verdandi.claude.runtime.v1.CommandsUpdated commands_updated = 26 (oneof event)

minors.summary: Explicit Claude Code system prompt preset with optional append (system_prompt_preset); absent prompt fields keep the Agent SDK's minimal prompt, while system_prompt remains a full replacement.

Wire for Claude Code's own turns, background work, notices and questions, ahead of their behaviour: no capability of this minor is advertised until the change that makes it work. TurnStarted.origin and cause, TurnCauseUpdated, CliCycleStarted, TurnCompleted.origin_kind and num_turns, SendTurnRequest.client_message_id (cli_turns); typed_by_person on SendTurnRequest and SteerTurnRequest (human_origin); parent_tool_use_id on ToolCallStarted, ToolCallCompleted, TextDelta and ThinkingDelta (subagent_frames); BackgroundTasksChanged and TaskEvent (background_tasks); TaskEvent.workflow_progress (workflow_progress); ClaudeHostPolicy.per_task_stop and the StopTask RPC (task_control); the GetTaskOutput RPC (task_output); SessionNotice (session_notices); ConversationReset (conversation_reset); CreateSessionRequest.client_interactions, InteractionRequested, InteractionResolved and the ResolveInteraction and GetInteractionState RPCs (structured_questions_v1); error codes TASK_NOT_FOUND, TASK_OUTPUT_UNAVAILABLE, INTERACTION_NOT_FOUND and INTERACTION_ANSWER_REFUSED. Until their capabilities are advertised, typed_by_person, per_task_stop and client_interactions.questions are refused with INVALID_CONFIGURATION and the four RPCs answer UNIMPLEMENTED. SessionEvent 27-29, CreateSessionRequest 12 and HandshakeResponse 20 are reserved.
